title: Rav Achdevoi bar Avin
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He reports Rav, as cited in Yuchasin; Seder HaDorot wrote, “I have not found it.” Hyman says this is indeed the reading in Dikdukei Soferim at Avodah Zarah 34b; the Gemara texts Hyman uses have only “Rav Achdevoi said that Rav said.”[^1]

notes.text: The checked Avodah Zarah 34b paragraph has “Rav Achdevoi said that Rav said,” without bar Avin. The patronymic in Hyman’s heading and his reports about Yuchasin, Seder HaDorot and Dikdukei Soferim remain attributed reports, not freshly verified apparatus readings or an identity binding.
